cb17_common.STOP_RULE: 3 CPU-hours per family; a job failing twice for the same non-transient reason stops and is recorded; no re-screen of a failed CB17 test

cb17_pre.AGREEMENT_BASE: the base of the agreement rule is every non-sports CB13-T SCREEN fill that resolves to one traded token and one transaction (probe P1: 971); a fill whose resolved prints carry no single BUY/SELL side counts as NON-agreement overall and in every cell (section 2.3: unknown never counts as met)
cb17_pre.BRANCH_T_CONSEQUENCE: family A is withdrawn uncounted before its part commit (CB15-L precedent); part A is never committed; q0407 builds E features only
cb17_pre.B_ACTIVITY_RECIPE: activity = pre-decision |dm| (cents) from the previous pass's first sweep to the decision sweep; global cut points (terciles) over worn non-sports eligible units; frozen in part B; never recomputed
cb17_pre.B_IMBALANCE_RECIPE: imbalance = (B5 - A5) / D1 at the second sweep, D1 = depth_bid_5c + depth_ask_5c of the first sweep; global tercile cut points over worn non-sports touch-unchanged units; frozen in part B
cb17_pre.COST_RECIPE: entry at the ask walked to the far edge of the lowest depth band that holds the position (1c band: ask + 1c; 5c band: ask + 5c; otherwise not executable within 5c), exit at the bid walked the same way; round-trip cost per share = (entry - exit) in cents plus the taker fee r x p x (1 - p) on both legs; an upper bound (EXECUTION_COSTS execution model)
cb17_pre.C_ABS_DM_RULE: section 2.6 leaves open which member's |dm_int| places a multi-member event-interval in a band: part pre declares the MEAN of |dm_int| over the unit's qualifying members (|dm_int| >= 0.5c), the same quantity at every level; the window part C may restate it but not change it
cb17_pre.C_TRAILING_RECIPE: cut points are the event's own terciles of r (and of dV) over its earlier traded intervals in the window; r_k, r_(k+1) and later never enter; fewer than 6 prior -> thin history, excluded and counted
cb17_pre.GAS_RULE_TEXT: GAS (signing gate; binding under branch S; window job q0408, NOT implemented in part pre): on SCREEN_8's touch-consistent subset (CB13-T's rule by pin) the same agreement rule must hold (overall >= 97% with Wilson 95% lower bound >= 0.95 and n >= 800, and >= 97% in every touch-age band, price band and class with n >= 100); both the Data API side and the touch-derived side are features, no mark is read; otherwise A1 is 'not testable (signing)', counted

INFORMATIVENESS.binary: numerator = units in (unit x stratum) cells holding both labels; denominator = all units of the test (A: the units of A1, i.e. units in (market x d) cells holding both labels; B1: all old / fresh units)
INFORMATIVENESS.continuous: numerator = units in (unit x stratum) cells with >= 2 units and x not constant in the cell; denominator = all B2 units
INFORMATIVENESS.selection: the finest level (0 finest) whose worn-data share >= 60%; if none, level 2 and the window's 50% rule binds; A's share is computed on the selected branch's population
INFORMATIVENESS.three_class: numerator = transfer and mint-heavy units in cells holding at least one transfer and one mint-heavy unit; denominator = all transfer and mint-heavy units (merge-heavy units are reported, not in the share)

levels.0: P band(3) x size band(3) x UTC 6h band(4) x spread band(4) = 144
UTC 6h band(4) x spread band(4) x activity tercile(3) x reward programme(2) = 96
levels.1: activity tercile(3) x UTC 12h band(2) x spread {<=2c, >2c} = 12

levels.0: UTC 6h band(4) x spread band(4) x activity tercile(3) x imbalance tercile(3) = 144
UTC 6h band(4) x |dm_int| band(3) x trailing dV tercile(3) x moving members {1, >=2}(2) = 72

cb17_pre.P1_NEXT_ACTION: a mismatch is investigated, never adjusted; the branch is not recorded until it matches or the difference is explained

PROXIES.A: pre-fill move d x (touch-capture mid - mid of the capture before it), cents
PROXIES.B1: L_pre: excursion beyond the touch of two passes earlier, evaluated at the mid one pass earlier, on old vs fresh today
PROXIES.B2: dm_pre: previous pass's first-sweep mid to the decision mid, cents, on x / SD_x
PROXIES.C: C_pre = sign(dm_int) x (m_(k-1) - m_(k-2)), cents, on the transfer and merge indicators
PROXIES.E: same, first-day versus later within market

cb17_pre.SE_RECIPE: fixed-effect OLS of the pre-outcome proxy on the family's label/state, demeaned within the declared unit; cluster-robust CR1 sandwich per way; the written number is the SE of the tested coefficient, the max over ways with G >= 15 (CR2 / wild bootstrap belong to the window part); no point estimate of any proxy is returned or written; MDE = 3.80 x SE
cb17_pre.SIDE_USE: q0400 reads the Data API side for two things only: the agreement count of the branch rule and the sign of the side-signed (S) population it builds for the strata shares and planning SEs; no other CB17 job reads it (section 1.4 whitelists)

cb17_census.memory: streaming: one capture, sweep or day file at a time; compact arrays for the B frame (q0401 <= 800 MB)
never_read: any capture or sweep after a unit's decision time (the next-pass check reads presence and the two-sided state only)
cb17_census.static_rule: static sidecar attributes are taken from the first worn capture carrying the market (CB13 load_quote_index precedent)

disclosures.b_clock_anomaly: B units with a book age < -5 s or no stamp are excluded from the units, the cut points and B2 and counted (section 2.2)
disclosures.created_at_unknown: first-day age uses created_at of two pinned captures (2026-10-12T00:31:03Z and 2026-10-15T22:31:02Z); a market created after the first and gone before the second has no created_at and is counted 'unknown' (a bias against newly created, short-lived markets)
disclosures.first_day_bins: first day = age < 24 h; later = 1-7 d; > 7 d, negative and unknown ages are in neither group
disclosures.s_planning_se_path_key: S units carry CB13's path key where derivable from the print alone (the underlying of a PATH-SETTLED title, else 'event:<event id>'); the sidecar first-series-slug branch of CB13's key is not read by q0400 (series_slugs is not loaded), a declared deviation; SEs only
disclosures.s_pre_fill_gap: the S pre-fill proxy uses the capture before the touch capture whatever its age (no gap limit), as CB13-T's prev_mid does; SEs only
disclosures.static_index: end_date, liquidity, sports flag, reward, fee fields and series slug come from the FIRST worn capture carrying the market (CB13 load_quote_index precedent), not the capture at the decision

cb17_pre.no_outcome: no mark, outcome, resolution, wallet or later capture is read; the only post-decision field is static created_at
cb17_pre.partly_missing_side: a fill (or transaction) with any blank or unknown side among its prints is 'missing': non-agreement, and not signed in the S population (section 2.3, the conservative reading)
cb17_pre.q0403_lag_population: the receipt-lag population includes prints with no usable price or size (the reader keeps them since the P1 fix); lag needs only ts and recv_ts, so this adds counts and no bias
cb17_pre.rerun_rule: after a P1 mismatch the result is written with branch fields null and the job exits 2 (failed, investigated, never retried blindly); once the difference is explained a rerun writes to a NEW declared output path (e.g. pre_census_A_v2.json) with --supersedes <earlier file>; the earlier file is kept and its sha256 recorded (CB13 smoke_R_v2 precedent)

census.rule: no census path reads a row at or after the cut-off; a file or directory outside the window is refused

common.holdout: CB13-T HOLDOUT paths are refused; only creative_batch13/t_screen/{fills,labels}.csv.gz may be opened by a census
common.result_rule: counts, shares and standard errors only; a result with a key naming an outcome, a mark, a point estimate or a forbidden column is refused
common.stop_rule: 3 CPU-hours per family; a job failing twice for the same non-transient reason stops and is recorded; no re-screen of a failed CB17 test

wallet.note: no CB17 job reads or stores a wallet field or a transaction hash (tx16 is aggregated in memory and discarded); the Data API side field is read by q0400 only (the agreement count and the sign of its side-signed population)
